Simply, we help connect a bigger audience. Award Winning Expertise As a service provider you have an important choice to make when it comes the right provider of video streaming platforms. That’s why it’s good to know we have a wide range of multi-award-winning products designed for everyone from national networks to niche streamers. We’re proud of the accolades we’ve won, because they serve as a testament to the expertise and flexibility which have made us the perfect streaming partner. Our story Synamedia is a company of lifelong video obsessives and we’ve been a major driving force of incredible experiences and video innovation for over 30 years. Now we’re the largest global provider of video solutions for service providers and content owners. Leadership Tzvi Gerstl Chief Executive Officer Claire Lea Chief Financial Officer Steve Reeves Chief Revenue Officer Shauna O’Handley Chief People & Places Officer Eli Sharon Chief Technology Officer Ismat Levin Chief Legal Officer Shlomi Rosenberg Chief Customer Success Officer Close Tzvi Gerstl Chief Executive Officer Dr. Tzvi Gerst l is Chief Executive Officer of Synamedia, a leading provider of video software solutions that help operators, broadcasters, and media companies create, deliver, and monetize exceptional viewing experiences. A technology and business leader with more than 25 years of experience in the media and telecommunications industry, Tzvi has played a central role in shaping Synamedia’s strategy, innovation agenda, and operational transformation. Throughout his career, he has led large global organizations across engineering, product development, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, enterprise technology, and business operations. Before becoming CEO, Tzvi served in several executive leadership positions at Synamedia, including Chief Technology Officer and General Manager. He led the company’s product and technology strategy, accelerated innovation in cloud video platforms, streaming, advertising, and user experiences, and helped drive significant improvements in execution, customer success, and business performance. Prior to joining Synamedia, Tzvi held senior leadership roles at Cisco and NDS, where he led global engineering organizations and the development of large-scale video and software platforms used by operators worldwide. Tzvi holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science, specializing in scheduling algorithms, and has authored more than 25 academic publications. He is also a Dean Fellow at the Business School of the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, where he contributes to the development of future business and technology leaders. Under Tzvi’s leadership, Synamedia is focused on helping customers attract, engage, and monetize audiences through innovation, operational excellence, and the next generation of video experiences. Close Claire Lea Chief Financial Officer Claire is our Chief Financial Officer and has over 25 years experience supporting blue-chip and private equity businesses through growth and transformation, focusing on driving value creation in global tech, telco and media companies. Prior to joining Synamedia, Claire has held leadership roles at Vodafone, where she was CFO at Vodafone Roaming Services in Luxembourg from its inception in 2008 to 2012 and Dentsu, where she was CFO for UK & Northern Europe from 2013-2017 delivering multiple M&A deals along with restructuring and business transformation programmes. Since 2017 Claire has worked in private equity backed businesses, taking Investis Digital through a transformational growth journey to a successful sale to Investcorp in 2021; leading restructuring, divestments, carve-outs and consolidations at Framestore and Company 3; and supporting Inflexion in carving out the Healthcare division of Global Data. Close Steve Reeves Chief Revenue Officer Steve Reeves serves as Chief Revenue Officer at Synamedia, where he leads the company’s global revenue strategy across sales, commercial operations, and go-to-market execution. He is responsible for driving sustainable growth, strengthening customer partnerships, and expanding Synamedia’s leadership position across video, streaming, and SaaS solutions. With more than 30 years of experience in the media and technology industries, Steve has built a reputation for combining deep industry expertise with strong commercial leadership. Throughout his career, he has led global teams across sales, service delivery, professional services, and business operations, helping organizations navigate industry transformation while accelerating growth and delivering business outcomes for customers. Since joining the business in 1995, Steve has held a number of senior leadership positions spanning professional services, sales, and commercial operations. He has played a key role in strengthening Synamedia’s go-to-market capabilities, expanding strategic customer relationships, and supporting the evolution of the company’s portfolio to address the rapidly changing video and streaming landscape. Sustainability. Responsibility. Our people care about the impact we have on the world and our local communities. Synamedia Horizons Every day, we empower the people that call Synamedia home to work in wiser, smarter, and kinder ways—and to make decisions that leave the world a better place For us Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) is about contributing to a better society based on the actions of every single employee – not just ‘top-down’ policies and programs. We call it Synamedia Horizons. Our core pillars Our Horizon’s programme is underpinned by three core pillars. Every employee’s encouraged to participate; by volunteering, living more sustainably or by helping support a more inclusive working environment. Respect We embrace our differences – it makes us stronger. We promote openness, diversity and inclusivity, and ensure everyone is respected, safe, comfortable and supported, with special regard to mental wellbeing. Sustainability We constantly seek ways of working more sustainably. We use renewable energy sources efficiently and have increased remote working, reduced air travel and support ‘cycle to work’ programmes, Trees4life and other green projects. Responsibility We love to hear about the positive ways our people are impacting their own communities. Our Time2Give programme gives everyone in the company paid leave to volunteer with their chosen charities. In addition, our DonateADay initiative enables employees to donate a day’s pay to charitable causes. Key Benefits of our forensic watermarking solution Session-based Watermarking Identify leaking accounts and protect your content against piracy. Hollywood studio approved Content aware forensic watermarking, technology with perfect fidelity and market leading robustness against video manipulation. Learn more Operational efficiency Reduce deployment costs with unique bitstream watermarking of compressed content. Protect content investment and reduce video piracy Live Sports Premium VOD Pre-Release B2B Distribution Music Identify leaking accounts in minutes Protect your live sports events and channels by inserting a forensic watermark into every stream. The unique watermark ID is used to pinpoint the source of leaks used by illegal pirate services, enabling streaming service to act, reduce content piracy, and protect their content investments. Disrupt piracy, cut the source of illegal feeds Terminate the source of content leaks within minutes. Once a compromised, leaking account has been identified, ContentArmor integrates with the service’s video platform to quickly end the viewing session, disrupting the pirate service. Reduce operating costs ContentArmor’s unique ability to generate A/B variants using compressed content is a huge cost saver. Other watermarking solutions require the video service to encode watermarked streams twice, doubling encoding costs. Pre-integrated with video infrastructure partners ContentArmor is pre-integrated with leading video encoders and CDN providers, reducing deployment times and accelerating time-to-launch. Combat CDN leeching with server-side watermarking Common attacks - like CDN leeching or DRM exploits – occur before an end-user device can insert a client-side watermark. The ContentArmor server-side solution is effective in instances when token duplication is used to steal content, and works across all end user devices without any client-side integration. Meet Hollywood studios’ 4K content licensing requirements Offer your users the latest blockbuster TV and movie content in 4K. ContentArmor is approved by the most demanding Hollywood studios for its perfect invisibility and robustness to common pirate attack techniques. Reduce operating costs and decrease VOD ingest times Thanks to the unique way ContentArmor applies the watermark to encoded content, ContentArmor isn’t tied to specific encoders and doesn’t require expensive double encoding per asset – providing significant cost savings and rapid ingest times. Enhance the security of your VOD workflow ContentArmor can insert watermarks on encrypted DRM protected content enabling just-in-time generation of video variants in a secure environment. Deter piracy from dailies and screeners ContentArmor is used by major content producers to protect pre-release content such as dailies and screeners, applying a unique ID to every asset and pre-release copy. It is pre-integrated and available in popular review & approval platforms and can be easily integrated with homegrown workflows. Reduce computing and storage costs Thanks to its post-encoding technology, ContentArmor doesn’t require a dedicated encode per recipient and also removes the need for double storage for the A/B variants for each asset. Optimise video ingest times ContentArmor enables rapid turnaround times and scales efficiently according to the number of assets and recipients. Identify the source of content leaks Identify the distribution source pirates are using to steal your content and inform the focus of your anti-piracy efforts with affiliates and business partners. Scale efficiently across your distribution network ContentArmor provides state of the art scalability for any number of affiliates enabling you to scale your watermarking infrastructure according to your distribution footprint. Trusted by major sports leagues to preserve video quality ContentArmor provides best-in-class video fidelity and is deployed and trusted by major sports leagues, and their distributors, around the world. Pinpoint the source of music piracy without compromising quality ContentArmor applies a unique audio watermark ID to any type of audio content to protect exclusive tracks while preserving the original quality of the artists’ work. Flexible integration for integration into any workflow As a software-based solution, both the watermark embedder and detector can be easily integrated into any audio production workflow. Combat common pirate manipulation techniques ContentArmor’s robust design maintains integrity across common pirate techniques such as very high loss compression. The Code does not cover every issue that may arise, but it sets out basic principles and ethical standards to guide all employees, directors and officers of Synamedia Holdings Limited and its affiliated companies (“Synamedia”) to foster a culture of honesty and accountability. We expect all employees to maintain high standards of behaviour and seek to avoid even the appearance of improper behaviour both at work and whilst representing us. The way we do business influences how Synamedia is viewed by our customers, partners, suppliers and also how we view ourselves and this should be at the heart of everything we do. The Code should also be provided to and followed by Synamedia’s agents and representatives, including consultants and contractors and third parties working with Synamedia. Third parties such as partners and suppliers should also adhere to the standards of behaviour and policies and procedures set out in the Code. One of Synamedia’s most valuable assets is our reputation for integrity, professionalism and fairness. We should all recognise that our actions are the foundation of our reputation and adhering to this Code and applicable law is imperative. You are under a duty to comply with the standards of behaviour and performance required by Synamedia and to behave in a reasonable manner at all times, incorporating the best practices as set out in this Code. If a law conflicts with any part of this Code, you must comply with the law. If you have any questions about these conflicts, you should ask your manager how to best handle the situation. Compliance with Laws, Rules and Regulations Obeying the law, both in letter and in spirit, is the foundation on which Synamedia’s ethical standards are built. All employees and those who work for us must respect and fully comply with the applicable laws of the territories in which Synamedia operates. Although not all members of staff are expected to know the details of these laws, it is important to know enough to determine when to seek advice from managers or other appropriate personnel. If requested, Synamedia may provide information and training sessions to promote compliance with laws, rules and regulations. Conflicts of Interest A “conflict of interest” exists when a person’s private interest interferes, or appears to interfere, in any way with the interests of Synamedia. A conflict situation can arise when an employee, officer or director takes actions or has interests that may make it difficult to perform their duties objectively and effectively. Conflicts of interest may also arise when an employee, officer or director, or members of their family, receives improper personal benefits as a result of their position in Synamedia. Loans to or guarantees of obligations for employees and their family members may create conflicts of interest. It is almost always a conflict of interest for a Synamedia employee to work simultaneously for a competitor, customer or supplier. You are not allowed to work for a competitor, customer or supplier as a consultant or board member whilst employed by Synamedia or whilst subject to any post-termination restrictions. The best policy is to avoid any direct or indirect business connection with our customers, suppliers or competitors, except on our behalf in the proper performance of your duties. Conflicts of interest are prohibited as a matter of Synamedia policy, except under guidelines approved by the Board. Conflicts of interest may not always be clear-cut, so if you have a question, you should consult with higher levels of management or Synamedia’s Legal Department. Any employee, officer or director who becomes aware of a conflict or potential conflict should bring it to the attention of a manager or other appropriate personnel or consult the procedures described in Section 16 of this Code. Corporate Opportunities Employees, officers and directors are prohibited from taking personal advantage of opportunities that are discovered through the use or knowledge of Synamedia property, information or position without the consent of the Board. No employee, officer or director may use Synamedia property, information, or position for improper personal gain or divert business opportunities away from Synamedia. No employee, officer or director may compete with Synamedia directly or indirectly. Employees, officers and directors owe a duty to Synamedia to advance its legitimate interests when opportunities arise to do so. Competition and Fair Dealing Synamedia seeks to outperform our competition fairly and honestly. Stealing proprietary information, possessing trade secret information that was obtained without the owner’s consent, or inducing such disclosures by past or present employees of other companies or organisations is prohibited. More Than 100 million Indians live with diabetes and that's something we can't live with. . Every family has a diabetes story. It is the defining health challenge of our generation. Perhaps you’ve seen it up close where your loved one is reorganizing their life after a diabetes diagnosis with the constant worry of rising healthcare costs. But diabetes doesn’t start in a lab report. It starts years earlier, in everyday habits. And that’s where it can be stopped. Arogya World Prevents Diabetes Before It Starts We bring science-based prevention and behavior change programs into schools, workplaces and homes meeting people where they live, learn, work and connect. Our approach is practical and rooted in everyday life with close to 30 million people reached through 2025. And we’re just getting started. Why India. Why Now. India is one of the most important places in the world to change the story of diabetes. The challenge is large, but so is the opportunity. When a prevention approach can work in India it can change millions of lives and offer lessons for the rest of the world on how to do it. It’s why we are now bringing what we’ve tested, refined and worked in India to families in the US too. Learn more about our doorstep health model Sign up for our newsletter It Takes So Little To Mean So Much A future where prevention reaches families before disease does is possible. A world with less diabetes is possible. A more hopeful future is possible. That is the future Arogya World is building. And your support makes possible.
